textRuns.value: Atlyn Resource Capacity — Sample Report Instructions & Usage Hints

PURPOSE & SCOPE: Atlyn Resource Capacity is a bounded, read-only matrix visual for comparing allocated workload against available capacity across resources and discrete time periods. It surfaces capacity exceptions (overloads, spare capacity, fully allocated), planned shutdowns/nonworking assertions, and missing data without pretending to be an automated scheduler or writeback engine.

FIELD ROLES & BINDINGS:
• Resource (Grouping): Stable identifier or display name (e.g., People[Resource] or Machines[Resource]).
• Period (Grouping): Model Date column (e.g., People[Period] or Machines[Period]). Do not bind an automatic date hierarchy.
• Allocated amount (Measure): Workload or demand measure (e.g., [Allocated hours] or [Machine allocated hours]).
• Available capacity (Measure): Capacity or availability target (e.g., [Available hours] or [Machine available hours]).
• Period order (Measure, optional): Unique integer ordering when non-standard chronological sorting is needed.
• Nonworking (Measure, optional): 0 or 1 flag asserting nonworking status (e.g., plant maintenance, holidays).
• Tooltip measures: Supplementary measures displayed in native tooltips (e.g., assignment count, source rows).

ANALYSIS CONTRACT & FORMAT SETTINGS:
• Compatible unit: Required text setting under Format visual > Analysis contract > Compatible unit (e.g., 'hours' or 'FTE'). Both measures must use this same unit; no unit conversions are made.
• Measures additive across periods: Toggle under Analysis contract. Leave OFF unless both allocated and capacity amounts are mathematically additive across non-overlapping periods. FTE, rates, and snapshots must keep totals off.

VISUAL STATE INDICATORS:
• [+] Spare capacity: Allocated < Capacity (under-utilized period).
• [=] Fully allocated: Allocated == Capacity (at target limit).
• [!] Overallocated: Allocated > Capacity, or positive allocation with zero capacity (overload exception).
• [N] Nonworking: Explicit model assertion of nonworking period (e.g., maintenance or holiday).
• [/] Unavailable: Both allocated and capacity are 0 (0 / 0).
• [?] Missing amount: Capacity or allocation is blank / not delivered.
• [X] Invalid input: Amount is non-numeric, negative, or invalid.

INTERACTIONS & KEYBOARD NAVIGATION:
• Selection: Click a cell to select and cross-filter related report visuals. Click visual background or 'Clear' button to clear selection.
• Keyboard: Arrow keys navigate cells; Home/End jump to row start/end; Enter/Space selects; Alt+ArrowDown moves to the next overload.
• Context Menu: Right-click or Shift+F10 anywhere on cells or empty visual space to open the native Power BI context menu.
• Cell Details: Focus a cell and click 'i' to view unformatted model numbers, or '?' for the in-visual guide.

SAMPLE PAGES:
• People · capacity grid: Weekly hours for 3 personnel. Features normal utilization, an overload (P01 Week 2), planned shutdown (P01 Week 3), and intentionally missing capacity (P03 Week 4). Compare with native table on page 2.
• Machines · capacity grid: Daily hours for 3 machines with additive row totals enabled. Features planned maintenance (M01 Day 2) and overload during maintenance (M01 Day 3). Compare with native table on page 4.
